parameters.content:
## Synthetic acceptance setup

Import this inactive template through the private n8n editor. Bind **automation-data/issue334_acceptance/migrator** to **Create Acceptance Structure**, **Grant Acceptance Access**, **Clear Reader Negative Residue**, **Cleanup Unexpected Reader Insert**, **Clear Feedback Residue**, and **Cleanup Feedback Fact**. Bind **automation-data/issue334_acceptance/runtime** to **Publish Initial Feedback Fact**, **Consume Feedback Before Refresh**, **Refresh Feedback Fact**, and **Consume Feedback After Refresh**. Bind **NocoDB Operator API** to every HTTP Request node and **NocoDB Acceptance Header** to **Acceptance Webhook**. Run structure, source sync, grants, source sync, probe, then feedback. Keep execution persistence disabled. NocoDB receives neither PostgreSQL credential.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $('Prepare Cleanup Page').last().json }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ id: $('Prepare Reader Negative Probe').first().json.readerProbeId, fact: $('Prepare Reader Negative Probe').first().json.readerProbeFact }) }}

parameters.value: ={{ '(id,eq,' + encodeURIComponent(String($('Evaluate Reader Insert Denial').first().json.recordId)) + ')~and(run_id,eq,' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize Acceptance Request').first().json.runId) + ')' }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ...$json, cleanupPageCount: 0, removedCount: 0 } }];
throw new Error('reader_insert_not_denied');

const context = $('Require Recovery Decision').first().json;
if (context.inserted !== true || context.read !== true || context.readerRead !== true || context.decisionUpdated !== true ||
  context.protectedUpdateDenied !== true || context.readerInsertDenied !== true ||
  context.publicSharing?.basePublicShareUuid !== null || context.publicSharing?.views?.length !== 2 ||
  context.recoveryCanary?.version !== 2 || context.recoveryCanary?.state !== 'ready') throw new Error('probe_evidence_incomplete');
return [{ json: {
  ok: true,
  operation: 'probe',
  runId: context.runId,
  domain: 'issue334_acceptance',
  credentialProof: { throughN8n: true, credentialName: 'NocoDB Operator API' },
  inserted: context.inserted,
  read: context.read,
  readerRead: context.readerRead,
  decisionUpdated: context.decisionUpdated,
  removed: true,
  reflectedSchemas: context.reflectedSchemas,
  reflectedTables: context.reflectedTables,
  publicSharing: context.publicSharing,
  recoveryCanary: context.recoveryCanary,
  forbiddenOperations: {
    protectedUpdateDenied: context.protectedUpdateDenied,
    protectedUpdateStatus: context.protectedUpdateStatus,
    protectedUpdateEvidence: context.protectedUpdateEvidence,
    readerInsertDenied: context.readerInsertDenied,
    readerInsertStatus: context.readerInsertStatus,
    readerInsertEvidence: context.readerInsertEvidence,
  },
} }];

const request = $('Normalize Acceptance Request').first().json;
return [{ json: { ok: false, operation: request?.operation || null, runId: request?.runId || null, domain: 'issue334_acceptance', errorCode: 'acceptance_operation_failed' } }];

parameters.query:
WITH published AS (
  INSERT INTO app.acceptance_fact (id, run_id, fact)
  VALUES ($1, $2, 'original')
  RETURNING id, run_id, fact
)
SELECT id AS "factId", run_id AS "runId", fact, current_user AS "runtimeRole"
FROM published;

SELECT f.id AS "factId", f.run_id AS "runId", f.fact AS "initialFact",
  d.decision AS "operatorDecision", COALESCE(d.decision, f.fact) AS "effectiveBeforeRefresh",
  current_user AS "runtimeRole"
FROM app.acceptance_fact AS f
JOIN operator.acceptance_decision AS d ON d.run_id = f.run_id
WHERE f.id = $1 AND f.run_id = $2 AND d.id = $3;

WITH refreshed AS (
  UPDATE app.acceptance_fact SET fact = 'refreshed'
  WHERE id = $1 AND run_id = $2 AND fact = 'original'
  RETURNING id, run_id, fact
)
SELECT id AS "factId", run_id AS "runId", fact, current_user AS "runtimeRole"
FROM refreshed;

SELECT f.id AS "factId", f.run_id AS "runId", f.fact AS "refreshedFact",
  d.decision AS "operatorDecision", COALESCE(d.decision, f.fact) AS "effectiveAfterRefresh",
  current_user AS "runtimeRole"
FROM app.acceptance_fact AS f
JOIN operator.acceptance_decision AS d ON d.run_id = f.run_id
WHERE f.id = $1 AND f.run_id = $2 AND d.id = $3;
